coverage_broad.explantion: Both responses suffer from the same high‑severity failures: they each miss major aspects of the query (such as challenges, assessment strategies, and implementation guidance), display narrow/tunnel‑vision focus on benefits, and lack an introductory context defining maps and pedagogy. consistency_internal.explantion: Both response a and response b exhibit the same highest‑severity internal‑consistency flaw: blurred viewpoints / conflation of geographic maps, GIS/GPS tools, and mind‑mapping techniques.
